title: Quasialgebra structure of the octonions
note: The octonions $\mathbb{O}$ = ℝ_F[(ℤ/2)³] realised as the group algebra of (ℤ/2)³ twisted by a sign 2-cochain F that is not a 2-cocycle (dF ≠ 0) — octonion non-associativity as a pentagon-cochain deformation, the associativity-side analogue of the braiding/hexagon (quantum-group) deformation. The multiplication associator dF is a coboundary (cohomologically trivial); Albuquerque–Majid's nontrivial H³ class is the category associator of Vect_(ℤ/2)³^ω. Cited in the genus-4 octonion-recovery audit (docs/audits/2026-07-12-octonion-recovery-from-genus4-analysis.md). Full text held since 2026-11-15 as library/arxiv-math-9802116v1/ (owner upload, commit 890d9e21).
